title: At two events with campus-specific focal points, the existing shortage of space at ETH Zurich and its causes and possible solutions were discussed, as well as the current status of the higher-level area planning and the current and upcoming construction projects.
main_content:
At two events with campus-specific focal points, the existing shortage of space at ETH Zurich and its causes and possible solutions were discussed, as well as the current status of the higher-level area planning and the current and upcoming construction projects.

Would you like to watch the recordings of the events? You can find them on the video platform (in German).

The presented PowerPoint presentations of both events can be found here:

Bauliche Entwicklung der ETH Zürich – Campus Zentrum (PDF, 14.4 MB)

Bauliche Entwicklung der ETH Zürich – Campus Hönggerberg (PDF, 10.5 MB)
